guide.tagline: Stop your Mac and display from going to sleep while you work.
guide.summary: Keep Awake blocks idle sleep for the Mac and its display until you turn it off. It changes nothing permanent: turn it off, or quit Edith, and your normal sleep settings return. Closing the lid still sleeps the Mac.

steps.title: Turn it on
steps.detail: Use the Keep Awake card on Home or the notch, or the toggle in settings.

steps.title: Work without interruptions
steps.detail: Your Mac and display stay awake while it is on.

steps.title: Turn it off when done
steps.detail: Normal sleep settings come back right away.
